cards.card_text: Then comes a quick run of don'ts: no eating anything with blood still in it, no divination or sorcery, no cutting their bodies for the dead, no tattoo marks, and no cutting the hair at the sides of the head or clipping the edges of the beard.
cards.verse_text: You must not practice divination or sorcery.

cards.card_text: Moses names those ways: sacrificing a son or daughter in the fire, divination, conjury, interpreting omens and sorcery.
cards.verse_text: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices his son or daughter in the fire, practices divination or conjury, interprets omens, practices sorcery,

cards.card_text: Manasseh practices sorcery and divination, and he consults ___ and spiritists.
cards.verse_text: He sacrificed his own son in the fire, practiced sorcery and divination, and consulted mediums and spiritists.

cards.card_text: Through all of this, Manasseh stays far away from sorcery, mediums and spiritists.
cards.verse_text: He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and consulted mediums and spiritists.

cards.card_text: Babylon's many sorceries and powerful spells will keep those losses away.
cards.verse_text: They will come upon you in full measure, in spite of your many sorceries and the potency of your spells.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD tells Babylon to take her stand with her spells and sorceries, the ones she's worn herself out with since her youth.
cards.verse_text: So take your stand with your spells and with your many sorceries, with which you have wearied yourself from your youth.

cards.card_text: Horses, chariots, cities, strongholds, all GONE, and friend, that's like me walking into my bakery to find no oven, no counter and no apron, just a mustache on a gold base going "Hello?" Then the LORD goes on: "I will cut the sorceries from your hand…"
cards.verse_text: I will cut the sorceries from your hand, and you will have no fortune-tellers.

cards.card_text: Along with cutting off sorceries, the LORD says the people He's speaking to will have no ___.
cards.verse_text: I will cut the sorceries from your hand, and you will have no fortune-tellers.

cards.card_text: It's 'because of the many harlotries of the harlot, the seductive mistress of sorcery…'
cards.verse_text: because of the many harlotries of the harlot, the seductive mistress of sorcery, who betrays nations by her prostitution and clans by her witchcraft.

cards.card_text: Nahum says this mistress of sorcery ___ nations and clans.
cards.verse_text: because of the many harlotries of the harlot, the seductive mistress of sorcery, who betrays nations by her prostitution and clans by her witchcraft.
Prior to that time, a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and astounded the people of Samaria.

cards.card_text: Then comes the list: sexual immorality, idolatry, sorcery, hatred, jealousy, rage, rivalries, envy, drunkenness and more.
cards.verse_text: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery; idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions, and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like.

cards.card_text: The survivors in John's vision turn away from their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality and theft.
cards.verse_text: Furthermore, they did not repent of their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality, and theft.

cards.card_text: The angel says Babylon's merchants were the great ones of the earth, because all the nations were ___ by her sorcery.
cards.verse_text: For your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because all the nations were deceived by your sorcery.”
